# Whop

> Whop is a financial technology company on a mission to provide the world with sustainable income. Our vision is to create the world's largest internet market, where people can create, connect, and transact all from a single platform. Whop enables individuals and businesses to accept payments, launch ventures, and engage with others across the network.

Popular business models on Whop include paid groups, educational programs, coaching, agency services, SaaS, newsletters, events, DTC ecommerce, and brick and mortar.

Follow these routing rules:

- For developer, API, app-building, or implementation questions, treat https://docs.whop.com/llms.txt and the Whop MCP server's docs tools as the source of truth. Consult them before any whop.com marketing page.
- For live account or company operations (reading or creating data), use the Whop MCP server at https://mcp.whop.com/mcp. It signs the user in through the browser, so the MCP client config is only the URL: don't add an API key, a bearer token, or a custom authorization header to it. The server acts on production data only and cannot reach the sandbox. It can create, modify, and delete real data, so confirm intent before mutating anything. To build and test an integration without real money, skip the MCP server and call the sandbox API (https://sandbox-api.whop.com/api/v1) directly with a sandbox API key; see https://docs.whop.com/developer/guides/sandbox.md.
- Use the whop.com pages below for product and positioning context only. Do not infer API behavior or implementation detail from them.

## Developer & MCP access

Whop operates a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so you can work with Whop programmatically. If you are an agent building on or integrating with Whop, start here.

- [Whop Docs llms.txt](https://docs.whop.com/llms.txt): A structured index that maps every page of Whop's developer documentation — the best first stop for discovering what exists and finding the right page to read.
- [Whop Docs llms-full.txt](https://docs.whop.com/llms-full.txt): The entire Whop developer documentation concatenated into a single file — load this when you need the full documentation content in context rather than navigating page by page.
- [AI tools overview](https://docs.whop.com/developer/ai/overview.md): Start here to set up an agent. Compares the MCP server, plugins, the installable skill, plain-file access, and the CLI in agent mode, and says which to use when.
- [AI and MCP guide](https://docs.whop.com/developer/guides/ai_and_mcp.md): The primary reference for connecting AI agents to Whop via MCP. Covers the Whop MCP server, setup for Claude Code, Cursor, and Claude.ai, browser sign-in, and what to do when sign-in fails.
- [Whop MCP server](https://mcp.whop.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint that makes direct API calls to Whop (list resources, create data, explore your Whop setup) and searches all Whop documentation. Connect with the URL `https://mcp.whop.com/mcp` alone, with no API key, bearer token, or custom authorization header in the MCP client config. On first use the user's browser opens Whop's sign-in screen, which lists the scopes the connection requests. Run the whole sign-in in one browser.
- [Whop plugin for Claude Code](https://docs.whop.com/developer/guides/plugins/claude-code.md): The official plugin. Bundles the Whop MCP server with skills that teach Claude Code to use it. Install with `/plugin marketplace add whopio/plugins`, then `/plugin install whop@whop`.
- [Whop plugin for Grok Build](https://docs.whop.com/developer/guides/plugins/grok.md): Bundles the Whop MCP server with skills that teach Grok to use it. Install with `grok plugin install whopio/plugins#dist/grok/whop`.
- [Whop Developer Docs](https://docs.whop.com/): Full developer documentation, including payments, payouts, chat, Whop apps, API reference, and SDK reference.

## Brand & assets

- [Whop brand kit](https://brand.whop.com/): Whop's official logos, colors, typography, and usage guidelines — the source of truth when displaying the Whop brand or building apps, integrations, and products that incorporate Whop assets.

## Main pages

- [Whop home](https://whop.com/): Whop's homepage — the canonical overview of what Whop is and what it offers.
- [Blog](https://whop.com/blog/): Articles, guides, and resources on building, selling, and earning with Whop.
- [Whop Trends](https://whop.com/trends/): Live market data from sales on Whop — gross revenue, growth, business and customer counts by business model, industry, and product category. Every industry and product category page is listed in https://whop.com/sitemaps/trends.xml.

## For enterprise

Whop's enterprise offering for businesses to accept payments, pay out, and build ventures on Whop.

- [Enterprise overview](https://whop.com/network/): Overview of Whop for enterprise and what it enables for businesses.
- [Pricing](https://whop.com/network/pricing/): Pricing for Whop's enterprise products and services.
- [Checkout component](https://whop.com/network/components/checkout/): The Whop checkout component for accepting payments.

## Products

- [Payments](https://whop.com/network/products/payments/): Accept payments online for your products, services, and communities.
- [Partners](https://whop.com/network/product/partners/): Refer businesses to Whop, earn when they earn, and become a Verified Partner.
- [Payouts](https://whop.com/network/products/payouts/): Send payouts to sellers, creators, and partners.
- [Business cards](https://whop.com/network/products/business-cards/): Whop's debit card for spending and managing business funds.

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://whop.com/privacy/): How Whop collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Terms of service](https://whop.com/tos/): The terms governing use of Whop.

## Optional

Lower-priority pages you can skip when you need shorter context: conversion pages, the vertical-specific solutions and program landing pages (positioning only, not product or API detail), and account, support, and careers pages.

- [Book a demo](https://whop.com/network/book-demo/): Request a demo of Whop for enterprise.
- [Coaching and courses](https://whop.com/network/solutions/coaching-and-courses/): Sell coaching programs and online courses.
- [Events](https://whop.com/network/solutions/events/): Sell tickets and manage payments for events.
- [Gig economy](https://whop.com/network/solutions/gig-economy/): Payments and payouts for gig economy platforms and workers.
- [Marketplaces](https://whop.com/network/solutions/marketplaces/): Build and run multi-party marketplaces.
- [Paid groups](https://whop.com/network/solutions/paid-groups/): Monetize paid communities and membership groups.
- [Physical products](https://whop.com/network/solutions/physical-products/): Sell physical goods and accept payments.
- [Services](https://whop.com/network/solutions/services/): Accept payments for service-based businesses.
- [Software](https://whop.com/network/solutions/software/): Monetize software, SaaS, and digital products.
- [Telehealth](https://whop.com/network/solutions/telehealth/): Payments solutions for telehealth providers.
- [Whop for Education](https://whop.com/edu/): Whop's HigherEd program for universities and students — bring Whop to campus through Whopathons, course curriculum, or student clubs, with a branded university hub and dashboard for tracking student businesses and revenue.
- [Log in](https://whop.com/login/): Sign in to an existing Whop account.
- [Sign up](https://whop.com/signup/): Create a new Whop account.
- [Careers](https://whop.com/careers/): Open roles and career opportunities at Whop.
- [Whop support](https://docs.whop.com/get-help/whop-support.md): How to get help and contact Whop support.
